name: Qingdao Port International Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Port International Co., Ltd. operates the Port of Qingdao. It operates through five segments: Container Handling and Supporting Services; Dry Bulk Cargo Handling and Related Services; Liquid Bulk Handling and Supporting Services; Logistics and Port Value-Added Services; and Port Auxiliary Services. The company is involved in the loading and discharging of containers, loading, unloading, storage, transportation, and port management of crude oil and other liquid bulk cargoes metal ores, coal, grains, general cargo, and other goods.
